LESSON: MONEY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurements
Topic 3.3: Money
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Money, part of Measurements in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we pay for goods on hire purchase?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. visit or invite resource persons from different financial institutions in the neighborhood of the school or home and gather information about simple and compound interests offered on deposits (principal). Learners such as those with brittle bone disease should be kept off slippery and rugged terrains while those with conditions such as epilepsy/ asthma, from possible triggers such as heights/ water bodies and cold/ dust/ pollen grains respectively. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. visit or invite resource persons from different financial institutions in the neighborhood of the school or home and gather information about simple and compound interests offered on deposits (principal). Learners such as those with brittle bone disease should be kept off slippery and rugged terrains while those with conditions such as epilepsy/ asthma, from possible triggers such as heights/ water bodies and cold/ dust/ pollen grains respectively. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Money together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: as the learner gathers information about simple and compound interests offered on

deposits (principal) in different financial institutions.

35

• Critical thinking and problem solving: as the learner determines Appreciation and Depreciation using step by step methods

and discuss what goods are worth investing in or buying.

• Digital literacy: as the learner do search on online shopping platforms or other sources on different types of goods for

consumer awareness.

Values

Responsibility: as the learner makes responsible choices on shopping goods that they appreciate in value.
